About — BP&O - Branding, Packaging and Opinion

name: BP&O
summary: Blog reviewing logo, brand identity and packaging design, with browsable archives of logos, posters and logotypes.
description: Written reviews and opinion on logo, brand identity, packaging and graphic design, founded by Richard Baird and now run with an editorial team as a 'live archive'. Posts are organised into themed collections (posters, logotypes, product shots, can design, signage …) and a logo archive filterable by category, colour and typeface; free to read, with a BP&O Plus membership for extras.
contains: reviews of logo, brand identity and packaging projects
23 themed collections including posters, logotypes, product shots, illustration and colour palettes
logo archive browsable by category, colour, typeface and tag
written by founder Richard Baird with an editorial team
